offering_description.value: Franchises a portfolio of boutique fitness studio brands (Pilates, yoga, cycling, barre, strength, stretching and others) to local franchisee owners. Earns franchise fees, royalties and equipment and merchandise sales, and provides marketing, technology and training platforms. Consumers attend classes at franchised studios.

primary_products.value: franchise licenses; fitness equipment; branded merchandise

primary_services.value: franchise support and training; marketing services; fitness studio software and technology

customer_segment.value: B2B: franchisees and studio owners buying franchises, equipment and support services; B2C: fitness studio members paying for classes and memberships

end_markets.value: boutique fitness; health and wellness; franchising

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: franchise fees and ongoing royalties from franchised studios; product sales: equipment and merchandise sold to franchisees; service fees: marketing fund, technology and other franchisee support fees; subscription: software and membership platform fees
revenue_model.category: licensing or royalties; product sales; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and licenses boutique fitness brands to franchisees, who operate studios serving consumers; service provider: provides franchisees training, marketing and technology support

geography_served.value: global: United States plus Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Middle East franchise studios

specialization.value: related lines: multiple boutique fitness brands such as Pilates, yoga, cycling, barre and strength, sharing franchise model

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: franchise sales to prospective franchisees and master franchisees; own locations: franchised boutique studios and a small number of company-owned studios; online: class booking and memberships via branded apps and websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: franchise disclosure and registration rules (FTC Franchise Rule, state laws), consumer membership and data privacy rules

notes: Brand portfolio has changed over time (some brands divested or closed); current list and mix may differ slightly.
